label: The design configuration
subgoals: Locate config.mk under designs for the chosen platform
Name the design, RTL and SDC with DESIGN_NAME, VERILOG_FILES and SDC_FILE
Set floorplan and placement targets with CORE_UTILIZATION and PLACE_DENSITY

label: Sizing the core from utilization
subgoals: Divide cell area by utilization to get core area
Take the square root for a square core's side
Divide the side by the row height and round down for the row count

label: Reading the first results
subgoals: Find final metrics in the reports and logs directories
Trace negative slack to the SDC clock period
Relieve routing overflow by lowering utilization
